info.title: ActFlow
info.description: A simple workflow activity system to string together business logic.

options.name: --config
options.description: Target config file to use. This should be a JSON file, being a list of IWorker configs

options.name: --output
options.description: Target file to output to [default: out.json]

options.name: --limiter
options.description: Limit how many activities are allowed to run for a single workflow [default: 100]

options.name: --persistent
options.description: Directory to keep persistent data in [default: .persistent]

options.name: --runner
options.description: Directory to keep active workflow runs in [default: .runners]
